guide.summary: Desert parks, the dam, museums and downtown attractions, with Strip and Arts District breakfasts, dinners, cocktail bars, bakeries and coffee checked against their own websites.
highlights: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
guide.tip: Reserve a timed-entry slot before driving to Red Rock Canyon: from October 1 to May 31 the Scenic Drive requires one for entry between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: é by José Andrés (The Cosmopolitan) serves Tuesday through Sunday only, and Discovery Children's Museum is closed Mondays except during holidays and school breaks. Hoover Dam's Visitor Center and tours close on Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: é releases tickets three months in advance on a rolling basis, with a waitlist. Red Rock Canyon needs a timed-entry reservation from October 1 to May 31, and the Neon Museum sells separate 2026 daytime (from $25) and evening (from $35) admission.

toolkit.label: Walk-in and queues
toolkit.copy: Hoover Dam's Guided Dam Tour ($40) is sold only on-site, first come, first served, and often sells out; the last tour leaves at 4:10 p.m. Fremont Street Experience is listed as open 24 hours, with Music Reels on the canopy at the top of each hour from 6pm.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Downtown Container Park is 21+ after 9 pm, and The Golden Tiki requires a physical, valid ID for its 21+ entry. SW Steakhouse (Wynn Las Vegas) asks for upscale casual chic dress and does not admit children under 5, while Legacy Club (Circa) bars sports attire, athleisure and swimwear.

guide.dek: Book your timed or ticketed slots first, then fill the gaps with walk-in downtown bars and cafés.
intro: Las Vegas reaches well past the casino floor, and the strongest day trips start with a booking. At Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area, run by the Bureau of Land Management, you need a timed-entry reservation for the Scenic Drive between October 1 and May 31 for entry from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The drive opens at 6 a.m. and closes at 5 p.m. from November through February. At Hoover Dam, the Visitor Center and tours run daily from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., except Thanksgiving and Christmas Day, and the $40 Guided Dam Tour is sold only on-site.

Downtown rewards an evening. The Neon Museum on Las Vegas Boulevard North opens from 3 p.m. to 11 p.m. between September and May, with 2026 daytime admission from $25 and evening admission from $35. The Mob Museum on Stewart Avenue opens daily from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m., and its basement speakeasy, The Underground, pours until midnight on Fridays and Saturdays. A short walk away, Fremont Street Experience says it is open 24 hours, with Music Reels playing on the canopy at the top of each hour from 6pm.

For dinner, é by José Andrés at The Cosmopolitan seats two shows a night, at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM, Tuesday through Sunday, and releases tickets three months ahead. SW Steakhouse at Wynn Las Vegas faces the Lake of Dreams, takes SevenRooms bookings and asks for upscale casual chic dress. Off the Strip, Lotus of Siam on Flamingo Road and Esther's Kitchen on South Main Street both take online reservations. Mornings are easier: Peppermill is open 24 hours from Thursday to Sunday, and Mon Ami Gabi at Paris Las Vegas serves breakfast from 7:00 AM.

If you travel with children, Discovery Children's Museum opens Tuesday to Saturday from 10am and Sunday from noon, and Pinball Hall of Fame charges per game rather than for entry. For a nightcap, Legacy Club sits on Circa's 60th floor and opens from 4pm, while The Golden Tiki on Spring Mountain Road is open 24 hours for guests 21 and over. Sweet stops include Bouchon Bakery at The Venetian, open daily from 6am to 5pm, and Dominique Ansel Las Vegas at Caesars Palace, open daily from 7AM to 9PM.
summaryCards: Pair an evening at the Neon Museum with a walk to The Mob Museum and Fremont Street Experience, all downtown.
Start at Bouchon Bakery at The Venetian, which opens at 6am, or Bungalow Coffee Co. on East Charleston, which opens at 7AM on weekdays.
Reserve Red Rock Canyon's timed entry and é by José Andrés tickets early; é releases seats three months in advance and is closed Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Every MGM Resorts property page (Bellagio, ARIA, Mandalay Bay, Park MGM and The Cosmopolitan venues) could not be fetched, so the Bellagio fountains, Bardot Brasserie, Shark Reef Aquarium, Best Friend, The Chandelier and Secret Pizza are left out; Freed's Bakery, Vesta Coffee and Mothership Coffee returned rate-limit errors, PublicUs had a certificate error, Golden Steer's site failed to load, and The LINQ's High Roller page had no readable content. None of these failures is evidence of closure. Hours were not published on the pages read for Springs Preserve, Esther's Kitchen, Bouchon (The Venetian) and Sphere; Lotus of Siam's hours were inconsistent; District Deli & Coffee showed only the current day's hours; and the Dominique Ansel shops are listed by resort without a street address. Several confirmed bars, cafés and restaurants showed current hours or booking but no 2026-dated content.
